body.prompt: An 8K resolution, photorealistic industrial design rendering of a quadcopter with a stretched X-shaped layout, 30cm rotor-to-rotor distance, 0.7:1 arm span ratio, 35° rotor angle, streamlined fuselage, 80cm wing curvature radius, 60° fuselage edge angle, foldable arms, carbon fiber frame, ABS propellers with nano-coating, anodized aluminum honeycomb grille, cold grey color scheme, blue LED light band, reinforced motor covers, modular quick-release connectors, and a GPS antenna discreetly integrated into the top surface, all highlighted under a 90° overhead view with soft 5500K lighting and high-contrast shadows. Each red dot is the exact centre of one motor: put the four motor hubs at the same positions in the frame as the four red dots, keep the same spacing between them, and run each arm along a blue line. Do not draw the dots or the lines.
